summary: Iteration 30 — E2E FRONTEND functional audit of Orrbbit (round 2 of 2). Regression of 4 defect fixes: 4/4 PASS (backend + UI where surfaced). Broad UI audit covered welcome, login, forgot-password, register, radar, nearby, pings, encounters, profile, edit-profile, email-preferences, feedback, person/[id] error state, professional-mode toggle + role switch, control-centre login+dashboard+users+verifications+reports+emails+audit-logs, non-admin redirect. Overall FE health: STRONG. 6 minor defects found, no crashes / no red screens / no blocking bugs.

regression_results.fix_1_register_min_password: PASS (backend 422 on 7-char AND UI shows 'Password must be at least 8 characters.'). Placeholder still says '6 characters' — see DEF-1.
regression_results.fix_3_banned_words: PASS (viagra/onlyfans/get rich quick/crypto pump/bitcoin investment blocked on both /api/professional/connect and /api/users/me/vibe-details with 400). Note: vibe-details only inspects keys public_summary/private_details/intent/context (not 'about') — behaviour by design per server.py:667.
regression_results.fix_4_dismiss_404: PASS (POST /api/pings/{nonexistent}/dismiss returns 404). Non-recipient dismiss test skipped (no ping available in that test run) but code path shares filter with 404-returning branch.

auth.notes: empty submit err, 7-char inline err, invalid-email lacks client-side msg (DEF-2), forgot-password nav+form, Explore Demo login, wrong-password error, welcome renders

onboarding.notes: Not deeply tested — Explore Demo bypasses onboarding; register flow was exercised via 3 attempts (empty/invalid-email/short-pw). Fresh QA_ signup + onboarding walk still recommended by main agent.

global_nav.notes: /nearby, /pings, /encounters, /profile all render; /person/nonexistent-id shows safe 'Out of range' (no crash); /email-preferences opens

radar_people.notes: Renders with 66 nearby, radar-blip-* and radar-cluster-* testIDs, Radius chip, Filters, People/Professional switch, DEMO badge

pings_encounters.notes: Both list screens render with seeded rows. Timestamps show large values (213 hr) — DEF-5 cosmetic.

profile_settings.notes: /profile renders full menu (menu-edit-profile, menu-change-vibe, menu-vibe-details, menu-saved, menu-plans, menu-privacy, menu-email-prefs, menu-location-privacy, menu-safety, menu-invite, menu-cities, menu-event-mode, menu-join-event, menu-campus, menu-networking, menu-communities, menu-ambassador, menu-waitlist, demo-env-card, demo-reset-btn, demo-switch-persona, demo-exit-btn, logout-btn, delete-account-btn). Edit-profile renders w/ photo-grid + save. Email-Preferences 6 toggles present.

professional_mode.notes: mode-people/mode-professional toggle, pro-role-switch w/ role-seg-need & role-seg-can, need-help-home renders '13 professionals nearby · 4 available now'.

control_centre.notes: Login via qa-admin@intro.control OK. Dashboard shows KPIs + System Status + charts (users 80, pros 13, verified 13). Users/Verifications/Reports/Emails/Audit-Logs all navigate. Non-admin /control/users redirects to /control/login. Audit logs shows recent mutations w/ 'Live' badge.

ui_bugs.issue: Placeholder text reads 'At least 6 characters' but fix now requires 8+. Update to 'At least 8 characters'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx (Password TextInput placeholder). Inline error text correctly says '8 characters'.
Invalid email format (e.g. 'not-an-email') is submitted; only server returns generic 'Request failed' (422). No client-side email regex check — poor UX.
Ping rows display '213 hr ago' etc. instead of days — cosmetic. Consider formatting: if hours>=48 show '9d ago'.

integration_issues.issue: Console error observed: 'The action REPLACE with payload {name:index} was not handled by any navigator. Do you have a route named index?' after successful admin login. Non-blocking (user reaches /control dashboard) but noisy log.

issues: No testIDs on inputs or submit button (control-email, control-password, control-submit missing). Automated testing must fall back to input[type=email]/text=Sign in. Reference: /app/frontend/app/control/login.tsx

Tab items (Radar, Nearby, Pings, Encounters, Profile) do not expose testID — the pressable divs have data-testid=null. Add e.g. testID='tab-radar' via tabBarButton or via _layout.tsx Tabs.Screen options.

blocked_device_items: Camera photo upload (Edit Profile photo-add) — cannot pick file via web
Pinch/zoom gestures on radar map (170 gesture handlers) — web supports scroll but not multi-touch pinch
Live GPS walking / geolocation-based radar updates — web fallback to Melbourne CBD
Push notifications (in-app popup mocked) — device-only per test_credentials.md notes
Non-recipient dismiss regression scenario — no live ping available in the tested demo seed for the specific cross-user path (test skipped, not failed)
action_items: MEDIUM: Update register password TextInput placeholder from 'At least 6 characters' to 'At least 8 characters' in /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx to match the enforced minimum.
LOW: Add client-side email format validation on /register (show inline error before hitting API) instead of relying on server 'Request failed' 422.
LOW-MEDIUM: Add testIDs on control/login inputs and submit (control-email, control-password, control-submit) — /app/frontend/app/control/login.tsx.
LOW: Add testIDs on the bottom tab bar items (tab-radar, tab-nearby, tab-pings, tab-encounters, tab-profile) in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx to make navigation deterministic in automation.
LOW: Improve relative-time formatting on Pings list — cap at days for values >= 48h (currently displays '213 hr ago').

LOW: Investigate the console error 'REPLACE payload name:index was not handled' on post-login redirect in /control — likely a stale router.replace('index') that should be router.replace('/control') or '/(control)/index'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:670 update_vibe_details enforces BANNED_OPPORTUNITY_TERMS ONLY on public_summary/private_details/intent/context keys — additional free-form keys (about, bio) are NOT scanned. Consider joining all string values for a stricter filter.
server.py:660 BANNED_OPPORTUNITY_TERMS extended list committed — viagra/onlyfans/get rich quick/crypto pump/bitcoin investment now caught.
professional_flow.py:95 _check_banned applied to message body on /api/professional/connect — good.
server.py POST /api/users/me/photos now uses PhotoIn(photo_url: str) — matches every other user schema.
server.py POST /api/auth/register RegisterIn.password has min_length=8; 7-char yields 422 with clear field error.
server.py POST /api/pings/{id}/dismiss returns 404 for nonexistent/non-recipient — parity with /decline achieved.
control/login.tsx has zero testIDs — inconsistent with the rest of the app (512 testIDs elsewhere).

rca_of_issue: DEF-1: When the backend password_min_length was raised to 8, the frontend register form's inline error text and validation logic were updated (verified: shows 'Password must be at least 8 characters.') but the TextInput `placeholder` prop was overlooked. It still literally reads 'At least 6 characters'. Grep for 'At least 6 characters' in /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx and change to 'At least 8 characters'. Zero-line safe fix. All other regression fixes verified end-to-end.
